data.title: Come il modello parla al database
data.html: <!doctype html><html><head><meta http-equiv="Content-Security-Policy" content="default-src 'none'; script-src 'sha256-RoOIoaTXwQqWtkV6FhmmLiGwCrP7GaHXGaK8nsPz4PQ=' pisa-bundle:; style-src 'unsafe-inline'; img-src data: pisa-bundle:; form-action 'none'; base-uri 'none'"><style>svg{width:100%}</style></head><body><svg viewBox="0 0 300 120" id="flow"></svg><script src="pisa-bundle://lib/d3.min.js"></script><script>/* the steps, from PISA_DATA */ const D = window.PISA_DATA; const svg = d3.select("#flow"); svg.selectAll("text").data(D.steps).join("text").attr("x", function(d, i) { return 10 + i * 100; }).attr("y", 60).attr("data-pisa-ask", "").text(function(d) { return d.label; });</script></body></html>
